pick.headline: Indian army storms the Golden Temple at Amritsar
pick.fbis: The South Asia Daily Report of June 5, 1984, carried Delhi Domestic Service and AFP on hours of gunfire between security forces and militants in the Golden Temple, which an official called 'an arsenal'; the army had not yet entered.
